# VAR-PLAN-0003: Manifest parse error

- Severity: error
- Area: PLAN

## Description

A manifest could not be decoded, or uses an Ingress API version varco does not support.

## Remediation

Fix the manifest, or export the Ingress with apiVersion networking.k8s.io/v1.
